relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Post hoc analyses of phase-3 trials of erenumab, fremanezumab, galcanezumab, and eptinezumab for the prevention of chronic migraine revealed that patients with MOH benefit from the treatment over placebo.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: The preclinical data suggesting that activation of the calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) pathway is involved in headache chronification

key_findings: Anti-CGRP mAbs including galcanezumab benefit chronic migraine patients with medication overuse in post hoc and real-world data
